items.html: Afterward the Yesod of Atik was clothed within the NHY of Arich, and then ZA was completed. For from its power, a skull and a Keter were made for ZA on the first day after the nine years; and behold, he is complete. Then he is already fit for the Mochin of birth, called the Mochin of Gadlut; and then he rises in the secret of MAN, for the need of the second Ibur of Mochin fit for coition, as said. And then he is fit for coition.
